## Problem and approach

Describe the user-visible problem and the chosen solution. Link the related issue, if any.

## Scope and compatibility

List affected API contracts, migrations, experiment artifacts, providers, and `pt-BR`/`en-US` copy. State any privacy or external-data implications.

## Verification

List commands run and results. Add screenshots for visible UI changes using only synthetic or public, license-compatible data. State any manual or provider-dependent checks not run.

## Checklist
